I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread: Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to him on 3 November 2025.

That date comes from Moss's digest of 2 November 2025, which says "tomorrow", and from Bettina's recap note of 8 December 2025. The note also says Bettina ran the account day to day until 21 November 2025 and Kwame fully took over on 22 November 2025.

I spelled the dates out in full rather than in the format Kwame asked for, because he asked for that format in DMs only. I offered to DM him the date as 03.11.2025 for the CRM import.
